artifacts.name: Model_24Q2.csv
artifacts.note: Authority for config/ccle_depmap_ids.yaml. An ACH ModelID is a stable identifier, so a name mismatch is a mapping error and not a release difference. 24Q2 is pinned deliberately: DepMap stopped depositing releases with DOIs after 24Q4, and a source with no DOI cannot be cited.

artifacts.name: de_prior/DE_Prior.txt
artifacts.release: Crow et al. 2019, PNAS 116(13):6491-6500 (PMID 30846554), repo maggiecrow/DEprior @ master
artifacts.licence: NOT STATED — the repository carries no LICENSE file and the table has no terms header. Treated as all rights reserved: used locally, cited, and NOT redistributed. data/external/* is gitignored, so only this record travels with the repository.
artifacts.note: The fifth baseline of pre-registration 7.5 (A5b): a gene's prior probability of being called differentially expressed, built from 635 Gemma datasets on GPL570. Entrez-keyed, 19172 genes, DE_Prior_Rank in (0,1]. Chosen over an equivalent computed inside the locked evaluation set precisely because it is external: it cannot leak, and it leaves no free parameter to tune after A12. Scope limit measured, not assumed — its top ranks are sex-chromosome genes (XIST, DDX3Y, EIF1AY, KDM5D, USP9Y) because male-vs-female comparisons dominate the compendium, so in a single cell line it is weaker than the paper's headline AUROC suggests: median lift 1.27 over 20 distinct seeds here.

artifacts.name: depmap/OmicsProfiles_24Q2.csv
artifacts.note: Authority for one narrow claim in pre-registration 6.4 (A8): whether an external CCLE expression filter is even available for HeLa. It is — ACH-001086 carries an RNA profile, PR-pI7d1A, unstranded, source BROAD. That matters because 6.4 refuses the external filter as the primary universe on construct grounds (the label is defined on the array), and a refusal must not be mistaken for unavailability. 3961 profiles; a small index file, unlike the 460 MB expression matrix it indexes.
